about_short_description.short_description: Uppercase operates as a D2C travel accessories company that offers sustainable products.

product.name: Eco-Friendly Laptop Backpacks
product.description: Backpacks designed to carry laptops and essentials, made from sustainable materials with padded compartments for protection.

product.name: Eco-Friendly Trolley Bags
product.description: Travel trolley bags made from sustainable materials, available in various sizes, designed for easy mobility and durability.

product.name: Eco-Friendly Duffle Bags with Wheels
product.description: Large duffle bags equipped with wheels and handles, made from recycled polyester, designed for convenient transport of bulky items.

product.name: Eco-Friendly School Backpacks
product.description: Backpacks designed for school children, made from sustainable materials, featuring ergonomic straps and multiple compartments.

product.name: Eco-Friendly Messenger Bags
product.description: Messenger bags crafted from sustainable materials, designed for carrying work essentials with organized compartments.
